Node NFT
The on-chain identity of this node: the SVG card it renders, the factories that mint it, and one-click buy / stake / revoke / claim.
Read from the public projection node/factories.json; the authoritative records stay in config/ (admin-only). No key material is mirrored.
First-load note: on this platform the projection is bound AFTER the first render, so on a cold visit every field below can read the empty placeholder — that means "not bound yet / unavailable", never "the record is empty". Expand the advanced details or reload once to bind it (measured 2026-09-28: no channel recovers on its own).
